dimensions.note: No secrets handled; SSH defers to the user agent/ssh_config with BatchMode=yes. The vppcfg check runs vppcfg plan (read-only) and cat of the configured boot file, through sudo when sudo=true; paths are restricted to absolute paths without shell metacharacters. Whoever writes the node definition already has that SSH and sudo access.
Structured logger placeholders; findings and lcp fallbacks logged.

vppctl: non-zero exit, unknown input (exit 0), socket errors, missing binary, timeouts become clear errors naming node and command. vppcfg: a missing binary or YAML means not managed and is skipped quietly; any other plan failure (e.g. permission) is reported as an info finding; a missing boot file is reported. health tolerates missing linux-cp, hardware-interfaces and vppcfg. The workflow sets allowFailure on the health steps and runs the verdict job on condition always, so every node is judged.

37 tests in test/: parsers (26.10 fixtures, 26.06 snippets incl. the detailed single-prefix FIB form), counter classes and rates, link and admin state, vppcfg drift (pe01 sub-LCP case, whole VLAN missing, stale boot file, order change, non-vppcfg node, other failures), upgrade chain order, method/global argument name collisions. Live: two edge routers over SSH+sudo (26.06): fib on full tables (1.08M v4 / 261k v6, summary fallback) and single prefixes, neighbors (133), show, vppcfg in sync, and vppcfg drift against an old YAML. Workflow @lstrandos/vpp-health tested live: two PEs pass; an unreachable node fails reachable/ok without stopping the others; a node whose stored health is ok but which is unreachable now fails (freshness check against run.startedAt); a warning node fails the run by default and passes with --fail-on high.
Read-only; counter deltas handle cleared counters; admin-down interfaces are not judged on counters. The workflow only reads (health) and asserts; reruns are safe.

No HTTP. vppctl output formats checked against VPP 26.10 and 26.06; vppcfg 1.1.6 output streams and exit codes checked live (plan on stdout, logs on stderr, 255 for unreadable config, PermissionError without sudo).
Each call has an AbortSignal (run signal + per-call timeout) passed to Deno.Command; stdin is null.

Docs use RFC 5737/3849 addresses and example.net; router-derived test snippets contain only generic interface names, no real addresses; fixtures are outside the archive. The shipped workflow names no nodes; nodes come from the nodes input.

Every resource field declared; new vppcfg resource and fib sources written as declared; schema-write conformance rechecked; method argument names checked against global argument names (a collision broke health once).
infinite lifetime with version GC (5-50); raw show output 30d/10.
Diagnostics only, every method is kind read by design.
All methods are kind read, so checks would not run.

version/lcp/interfaces/errors/vppcfg shared by their method and health with the same schema (vppcfg only written by health when the node is managed); fib/neighbors/show names include family, table, prefix, interface or command slug.
readResource used for previous interfaces/errors to compute deltas; failures fall back to no delta.
Manifest-only release for the workflow (2026.11.25.6); behavior version stays 2026.11.25.5 with its upgrade chain (.3, .4 no-op; .5 adds the vppcfg global arguments with defaults), guarded by a test.
